Grants an extra <void/>Scatter Grenade Ability Charge. Stacks with <void/>Chaos Accelerant's additional grenade charge.

Kills with <void/>Scatter Grenade spawn 4 additional scatter submunitions with no cooldown.

Scatter Grenades are faster and receive <void/>Chaos Accelerant's Tracking Bonus. This does not stack with <void/>Chaos Accelerant.
